text:
Avery (CEO): Quick cadence check — three asks this week: 1) greenlight two EU private rollouts, 2) freeze broad infra changes until rollouts validated, 3) cut infra spend by 5%. Short updates by EOD Wed please.

Ravi (VP Eng): Got it. Can the infra freeze be partial? we need a kernel patch for throughput. Propose canary-only to replacement nodes in us-west. @Sam any objections?

Sam (Head SRE): Partial freeze is fine. We'll gate kernel patch to canary window and monitor. I'll post a timeline in the ops channel.

ops-bot: Schedule created: canary window Tue 22:00-23:00 UTC, broader rollout Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC. Links: https://infra/rollouts/1807773333

Marta (VP Product): From product: prioritize onboarding docs + eval harness for private deployments. Need signoff on audit timeline by Fri. Also flagging: feature gating for function-calls in private GA — want to avoid surprises.

Lin (CFO): :money_with_wings: noted on the -5% target. Recommend pausing non-critical reserved capacity purchases until finance sync. I'll circulate the current spend breakouts.

Avery (CEO): Thanks. Two more items: prepare customer-facing SLA comms if latency regresses >10%, and get a one-slide exec readout ready by Thu morning (metrics + risks).

Ravi (VP Eng): Understood. I'll add canary instrumentation and a latency dashboard. @Marta can you assemble the one-slide with the key charts?

Marta (VP Product): Yep — I'll draft the slide and pull cost/latency charts from Console. ETA Wed 12:00.

Sam (Head SRE): I'll push post-canary logs and perf summary by Wed 04:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Reminder: incident playbook v2 deployed to /playbooks/incidents-v2. Link: https://docs/internal/playbooks#v2

Avery (CEO): Great — keep updates short in-thread. Appreciate the quick turn on this. :sparkles:
